# Golden Gate IPTV

> IPTV subscriptions for the USA: live TV and on-demand movies and series on Smart TVs, Fire TV Stick, Android, iPhone, Windows and Mac. Plans from $20 a month with a 7-day refund and 24/7 support.

## Key facts
- Standard plans: 1 day $7, 1 month $20, 3 months $37, 6 months $49, 1 year $77, 2 years $119 (1 device). 2-device and 3-device pricing is listed on the plans section.
- Premium plans: 1 year with 1 to 5 connections, $77 to $229.
- Orders and support are handled on WhatsApp.
- Refund: 7 days from purchase.

## Pages
- https://goldengateiptv.com/ : plans, features and FAQ
- https://goldengateiptv.com/blog : guides and articles
- https://goldengateiptv.com/install : installation guide
- https://goldengateiptv.com/reseller : reseller plan
- https://goldengateiptv.com/legal/refund : refund policy
